correctness.rationale: Projective orthogonality decomposes the graph into K_{q-1} components on isotropic lines and K_{q-1,q-1} components on paired nonisotropic lines. Their zero forcing polynomials are u^(q-2)(u+q-1) and u^(2q-4)(u+q-1)^2. Since fixed lines plus twice the paired orbits equals q+1, multiplication gives the claimed factorization. Minimum sets omit one vector per projective line. Real minimum rank adds as 1 per clique and 2 per balanced biclique, yielding q+1. Exact finite-field replay corroborates q=2,3,4,5.
